problem: The pack carries no overlay/dialog vessel and no wizard pattern. 'modal', 'dialog', 'overlay', 'wizard', 'onboarding', 'popup', 'scrim' all resolve UNDEFINED (search returns no hits). The Cadence consumer improvised a shared dialog vessel (white 16px, 35% ink scrim) and a three-step onboarding wizard, both marked.
insufficiency: Overlays are source-owned and accepted but unshipped: decisions.json W-17 (overlays, Gate 2 accepted) - 'Dialog: white 16px card, 48px padding, warm ink scrim (rgba(35,30,21,.35)); instant appearance (no motion defined; none invented).' The multi-step flow is also named in source evidence: raw/04-designsystems-one-mailchimp.md (lines 59, 67) - 'Campaign Builder - multi-step editor pattern with live preview, save-and-resume, and async send'. The pack carried neither, so dialogs and wizards can only be improvised.
reuse_case: Every consumer app needs dialogs (detail views, confirmations, forms) and most need a multi-step flow (onboarding, wizards); the vessel rules and instant-appearance discipline are app-independent.
composition_check: Existing elements cannot compose it: card language gives a surface but not the scrim, not the dialog-specific interior spec, and not the instant-appearance/no-motion rule; no recipe exists to bundle them (recipes.json empty). The wizard adds step structure + progress readout + action pills, but its vessel is absent from canon. One pattern entry for the vessel is the smallest carrier; wizards compose it with the progress pattern (sibling proposal).
